title: Stale grounded state after parent switch in select_parent()
description: In dodag.py select_parent(), when switching preferred parent due to link metric changes, gateway_centric is updated (line 613) but grounded is not. ParentCandidate stores gateway_centric but not grounded, so there is no source for the correct value during parent switch. grounded is only updated when receiving a DIO from the current preferred_parent (line 359), but after select_parent() changes preferred_parent, the check self.preferred_parent == neighbor_id fails if the DIO that triggered reselection came from a different neighbor. This causes stale grounded advertisement until next DIO from new parent. Fix: store grounded in ParentCandidate and update it in select_parent() alongside gateway_centric.
